about_the_game:
This game is still in very early development!

SAVE THE REALM FROM DIVINE WARFARE

Step into a realm torn apart by divine conflict. Lead a party from 5 playable heroes, resurrected by the Goddess of Light, to combat the encroaching forces of darkness. Experience the relentless cycle of death and rebirth as your mortal champions face an eternal struggle between hope and corruption.

STRATEGIC ROGUELIKE COMBAT

Immerse yourself in a turn-based tactics adventure where every run is a unique test of your strategic skill. Adapt to unpredictable foes, navigate random events, and unleash devastating synergies between your heroes in this unforgiving roguelike world.

ENDLESS HERO BUILDS

With over 100 unique hero abilities at your disposal, each run offers fresh opportunities to craft powerful builds. Enhance your party’s synergy through ability upgrades, unlock stat-changing Blessings as you level up, and discover more than 200 unique items to maximize your potential.

PLAY SOLO OR CO-OP

Lead your party on a solo journey or join forces with up to three friends in fast-paced co-op. Enjoy a dynamic system where all players act simultaneously, ensuring that no moment is wasted as you battle for the realm’s survival.

content_descriptors.notes: General fantasy medieval violence against heroes, NPCs, and enemies.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel or AMD
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 1080
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Realtek

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel or AMD
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia 1080

short_description: Step into a realm torn by divine conflict where every defeat is just another beginning in this roguelike, turn-based tactics adventure. Assemble your party, and defy fate in a world where every decision tips the balance between light and shadow.
